Description.Name: The Opening
Description.Details:
While the rescue operations were underway, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreAntonCorrigan],Corrigan]] launched a calculated strike against the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreKalskagCoalition],Band of the Damned's]] flank --- an assault meant to mask your recovery efforts.

The task force succeeded in driving the Band from their mining complex "stronghold", but victory was short-lived.  A sudden counter-attack shattered the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreTaskForceAcamar],task force]]'s advance.

Description.Name: Post Broken Halo
Description.Details:
That gamble cost Corrigan dearly, buying the Band the time they needed to withdraw...and ultimately escape the planet.

Yet neither side realizes a thrid force has been watching from the shadows.

A dark horse --- still unseen, and ready to move.
